results.title: Will your check book change? Old check book closed from January 1? RBI gave final answer - this message is fake
results.description: RBI has termed the viral claim of closure of old check book and implementation of new check book from January 1, 2027 as fake. The central bank has clarified that the existing CTS check books will remain valid even after December 31, 2026. The news of ban on checks worth more than Rs 50 thousand is also misleading. Account holders do not need to go to the bank to get the check book changed.
